mapper.select: SELECT TRAINING_JOB_CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME, SORT_ORDER, INCUMBENT_YN, HIDDEN_YN, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY FROM TRAINING_JOB_CATEGORY ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, TRAINING_JOB_CATEGORY_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRAINING_JOB_CATEGORY ( CATEGORY_NAME, SORT_ORDER, INCUMBENT_YN, HIDDEN_YN, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{categoryName}, #{sortOrder}, #{incumbentYn}, #{hiddenYn}, #{useYn}, NOW(), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE TRAINING_JOB_CATEGORY
CATEGORY_NAME = #{categoryName},
SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder},
INCUMBENT_YN = #{incumbentYn},
HIDDEN_YN = #{hiddenYn},
USE_YN = #{useYn},
UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy},
UPDATED_AT = NOW()
WHERE TRAINING_JOB_CATEGORY_ID = #{trainingJobCategoryId}
